{
  "candidate": "cand_0001",
  "parent": "seed",
  "iteration": 1,
  "baseline": {
    "val_reward": 0.35,
    "solid": 14,
    "flaky": 0,
    "failing": 26,
    "total": 40,
    "metric": "hard_no_recalc",
    "seed_state": "empty capability: prompt.md was 0 bytes (no system message sent at all) and task_template.md was absent (adapter built-in _TASK_TEMPLATE used)"
  },
  "environment_fault": null,
  "environment_fault_note": "No environment fault found. All 26 failures are capability failures. 463-17 hit a 60s block timeout, but from the agent's own openpyxl auto-vivification loop (ws[f'A{row}'] creates cells, growing max_row); it recovered and passed, so it is a capability trap, folded into prompt.md recovery guidance.",
  "clusters": [
    {
      "id": "A",
      "rank": 1,
      "name": "Formula written into an answer cell instead of a literal value",
      "tasks": ["267-18", "2768", "37378", "37456", "39046", "43436", "45635", "46897", "48588", "48620", "48921", "50768", "53383", "53647", "54144", "55049", "55979", "56563", "59196", "59595", "7902", "8942", "9569", "9726", "12864"],
      "n_tasks": 25,
      "scope": 25,
      "tag": "KNOWLEDGE",
      "root_cause": "Primary metric hard_no_recalc: evaluation.py::compare_workbooks loads the produced file with openpyxl.load_workbook(data_only=True) and REWARD_RECALC defaults to 0, so nothing recalculates. openpyxl saves a formula with no cached <v>, so the graded cell reads back None. Most instructions literally ask for a formula ('I need a formula...', 'use INDEX/MATCH', 'adapt this macro'), so the agent complied correctly and scored 0.",
      "sub_cases": [
        {
          "name": "formula already present in the answer cell",
          "tasks": ["267-18", "48620", "54144", "9726"],
          "note": "pre-existing formulas also lose their cached value on save, so leaving or text-editing them is equally fatal"
        },
        {
          "name": "reported as 'Excel error text (e.g. #N/A)'",
          "tasks": ["37456", "45635", "53383", "55979", "59595", "8942"],
          "note": "same cluster seen through the recalculated diagnostic copy. None wrote an '#N/A' literal and none used data_only=True; they wrote post-2007 functions bare (AGGREGATE, UNIQUE, TEXTJOIN, FILTER, TEXTSPLIT, MAXIFS) which the xlsx grammar requires as _xlfn.*, so LibreOffice resolved them to #NAME?/#VALUE!. Verified against the saved artifacts by a subagent."
        }
      ],
      "fixed_by_edits": ["E1", "E2", "E9", "E10"]
    },
    {
      "id": "B",
      "rank": 2,
      "name": "Blanket-overwriting the whole answer_position rectangle",
      "tasks": ["48588", "50768", "54144", "48620", "59196"],
      "n_tasks": 5,
      "scope": 5,
      "tag": "KNOWLEDGE+BEHAVIORAL",
      "root_cause": "answer_position is the CHECKED range, not a box to fill. Cells already holding the right value are typically the user's hand-done worked example (48588: B2:B18 pre-filled and correct, agent overwrote all 42 cells), and cells whose answer is genuinely blank must stay blank (50768: 6 of 9 matrix boxes).",
      "fixed_by_edits": ["E4", "E9", "E10", "E11"]
    },
    {
      "id": "C",
      "rank": 3,
      "name": "No verification and no inspection - effectively single-shot",
      "tasks": ["all 26 failing"],
      "n_tasks": 26,
      "scope": 26,
      "tag": "BEHAVIORAL",
      "root_cause": "The adapter's built-in template said 'once that file exists, you are done'. Median 3 of 30 rounds used; 59196 and 51-12 did zero inspection rounds. 3 of the 4 non-formula failures had the ground truth sitting in the sheet (59196 H3='D'; 43436 header text + neighbouring example formula; 51-12 row-2 markers) and none were read.",
      "fixed_by_edits": ["E9", "E10"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D",
      "rank": 4,
      "name": "Right answer, wrong Python type",
      "tasks": ["12864", "59196", "54144", "56563", "9726", "48588"],
      "n_tasks": 6,
      "scope": 6,
      "tag": "KNOWLEDGE",
      "root_cause": "transform_value rounds numbers to 2dp and coerces numeric-looking strings, then compare_cell_value rejects on type(v1) != type(v2). Text written as a number, or a date written as a string, fails. All 6 are also cluster A, so A's fix is a precondition for D being observable.",
      "fixed_by_edits": ["E3", "E10"]
    },
    {
      "id": "E",
      "rank": 5,
      "name": "Loose prose outranked by the in-sheet specification",
      "tasks": ["43436", "59196"],
      "n_tasks": 2,
      "scope": 2,
      "tag": "KNOWLEDGE",
      "root_cause": "43436 counted records open DURING the month although the column header says 'Open by of end of May 2022' and the user's own neighbouring example formula H2=COUNTIFS(B:B,G2,D:D,\"\") spells out the end-of-period reading; all 5 cells came out uniformly high. 59196 anchored INDEX($D$1:$G$1,...) on an empty row 1 because the pandas preview returned all-Unnamed columns - the real headers are in row 2.",
      "fixed_by_edits": ["E7", "E10", "E11"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F",
      "rank": 6,
      "name": "Float threshold comparison overshoot",
      "tasks": ["51-12"],
      "n_tasks": 1,
      "scope": 1,
      "tag": "KNOWLEDGE",
      "root_cause": "value >= ref * 1.10 misses exact 10% steps because 100 * 1.10 == 110.00000000000001; the agent counted 2 where golden is 4. Only pure-computation failure in the set.",
      "fixed_by_edits": ["E7"]
    }
  ],
  "edits": [
    {
      "id": "E1",
      "file": "prompt.md",
      "section": "Rule 1",
      "cluster": "A",
      "lever": "added sourced rule + stated reason",
      "summary": "Answer cells must hold literal values, never formulas; states the grading mechanism (data_only=True, no recalc, openpyxl stores no cached result) and that a named method is a preference, not the deliverable.",
      "blast_radius": "WIDE but safe-by-inspection: 0 of 14 passing tasks write a formula as their graded answer. 6698 changes method (literal int instead of formula + hand-patched cached <v>) but not graded content.",
      "verified": "Traces 2768/37378/46897/9569 assign '=IF(...)' strings; confirmed in source via adapter REWARD_RECALC default '0' and evaluation.py load_workbook(data_only=True).",
      "task_specific": false
    },
    {
      "id": "E2",
      "file": "prompt.md",
      "section": "Rule 1 points 2-3",
      "cluster": "A (sub)",
      "lever": "added sourced rule",
      "summary": "A formula already sitting in an answer cell also cannot stand; recover its value from a second data_only=True load of the input and never save that handle.",
      "blast_radius": "Phrased with an explicit deference clause ('if the instruction says that cell should end up blank, follow the instruction') so it cannot force a value into 382-10's A18, which must be cleared to None.",
      "verified": "267-18 text-edited the existing G1:G2 formulas; 48620/54144/9726 left or replaced input formulas; all read back empty.",
      "task_specific": false
    },
    {
      "id": "E3",
      "file": "prompt.md",
      "section": "Rule 2",
      "cluster": "D",
      "lever": "tightened the output contract",
      "summary": "Four-row type table (number / date / text / nothing) read off transform_value and the type() equality check; normalise only the comparison, write back the original value.",
      "blast_radius": "BOUNDED-by-wording: the 'normalise only the comparison' clause was added specifically so 463-17 and 416-15 keep writing original values. Formatting line softened so 560-12, 6698 and 80-42 still carry out explicitly requested formatting.",
      "verified": "12864 wrote a number where str was expected; 9726 a string where datetime was expected.",
      "task_specific": false
    },
    {
      "id": "E4",
      "file": "prompt.md",
      "section": "Rule 3",
      "cluster": "B",
      "lever": "added sourced rule",
      "summary": "answer_position is checked, not a box to fill: do not blanket-overwrite, pre-filled cells are the user's worked example, a cell whose answer is nothing stays empty.",
      "blast_radius": "Two carve-outs added after the passing-trace audit: (i) match an absence convention the neighbouring rows already use (80-42 passes only because it writes literal 'None'/'N/A'); (ii) clearing is correct when the instruction's uniformly-applied rule covers the cell (382-10).",
      "verified": "48588 printed its own pre-filled B2:B18 and then overwrote all 42 cells; 50768 filled all 9 matrix boxes when golden has 3.",
      "task_specific": false
    },
    {
      "id": "E5",
      "file": "prompt.md",
      "section": "Rule 4",
      "cluster": "cross-cutting",
      "lever": "added sourced rule",
      "summary": "Sheet resolution: strip quotes from either end (quoting is sometimes lopsided), and with no '!' prefix the graded sheet is wb.sheetnames[0], not wb.active.",
      "blast_radius": "BOUNDED: 0 of 14 passing tasks use wb.active; read directly off compare_workbooks.",
      "verified": "Source: evaluation.py falls back to wb_gt.sheetnames[0] and lstrip(\"'\").rstrip(\"'\") the prefix.",
      "task_specific": false
    },
    {
      "id": "E6",
      "file": "prompt.md",
      "section": "Rule 5",
      "cluster": "cross-cutting",
      "lever": "added sourced rule (narrowed after audit)",
      "summary": "Bans DataFrame.to_excel / pd.ExcelWriter only, with the reason (renames the sheet -> score 0, drops sheets, blanks NaN); recommends read_excel(header=None, dtype=object, keep_default_na=False) for reading; allows zipfile/XML surgery as a fallback.",
      "blast_radius": "The XML-surgery allowance exists because 463-17 and 6698 both pass that way; an earlier 'edit the openpyxl workbook and save it' draft would have regressed both.",
      "verified": "Passing-trace audit of 463-17 and 6698.",
      "task_specific": false
    },
    {
      "id": "E7",
      "file": "prompt.md",
      "section": "Working style and recovery",
      "cluster": "E, F",
      "lever": "added sourced rule + stated reason + recovery guidance",
      "summary": "In-sheet header text and the user's nearby example outrank loose prose; scale percentage thresholds to integers; max_row auto-vivification warning; never re-run a failing block unchanged.",
      "blast_radius": "Additive guidance; no passing trace depends on the opposite of any of these.",
      "verified": "43436 and 51-12 traces; 463-17's 60s timeout from ws[f'A{row}'] growing max_row.",
      "task_specific": false
    },
    {
      "id": "E9",
      "file": "task_template.md",
      "section": "Rounds 1-3 + interaction contract",
      "cluster": "C (and A, B)",
      "lever": "restructure into an ordered procedure",
      "summary": "Replaced the 2-step 'write the file and you are done' contract with READ -> SOLVE -> CHECK, and deleted 'once that file exists, you are done', replacing it with 'you are done when the Round-3 output is all-clear'.",
      "blast_radius": "WIDE. Turn headroom is ample (max observed 6 of 30 rounds), and the contract explicitly says to stop once the readback matches, so no passing task should run out of turns or re-save.",
      "verified": "Every failing trace stopped one round after saving; median 3 of 30 rounds.",
      "task_specific": false
    },
    {
      "id": "E10",
      "file": "task_template.md",
      "section": "Round 3 code block",
      "cluster": "A, B, D",
      "lever": "worked example / code enforcement",
      "summary": "A copyable self-asserting check: range_boundaries over answer_position clipped to max_row, assert no cell holds a formula, diff the range against the input to expose over-wide or under-wide writes, print repr+type of every changed cell.",
      "blast_radius": "Bounded deliberately: an earlier version walked 80-42's 95,988-cell range (A2:L8000) and risked the 60s limit on a passing task; the max_row clip reduces it to 12,012 and every printout is sliced.",
      "verified": "Logic simulated against a faithful Worksheet.__getitem__ stub: flags a leftover formula on both the 'B2:B12' and single-cell 'B4' shapes, excludes untouched example cells from 'changed', and bounds correctly across 5 real answer_position shapes.",
      "task_specific": false
    },
    {
      "id": "E11",
      "file": "task_template.md",
      "section": "What these fields mean + two-load setup",
      "cluster": "A, B, E",
      "lever": "restructure + worked example",
      "summary": "Per-field semantics, the pandas-preview offset (preview row i == Excel row i+2), the all-Unnamed header-row warning, and the ws (edit/save) vs wsv (data_only read) idiom.",
      "blast_radius": "Additive explanation of fields that were previously unexplained.",
      "verified": "59196 anchored on the empty row 1 after an all-Unnamed preview.",
      "task_specific": false
    }
  ],
  "skipped": [
    {
      "item": "_xlfn. prefixing for post-2007 Excel functions",
      "reason": "Real and verified, but it only helps an answer that IS a formula, which Rule 1 forbids. Adding it would compete with Rule 1 and invite the agent back onto the losing path."
    },
    {
      "item": "Whole-column vs bounded range references recalculating text to 0 (12864)",
      "reason": "A property of the LibreOffice recalc path, not of the primary hard_no_recalc metric. Moot once literal values are written."
    },
    {
      "item": "Task-specific reasoning fixes for 43436 and 51-12",
      "reason": "These need correct reasoning, not a missing fact. Only the generalizable lesson behind each was shipped; no task id, value, date or answer appears in either file."
    }
  ],
  "techniques": [
    "read the scorer and adapter source (evaluation.py, adapter.py) rather than trusting the feedback strings",
    "3 parallel read-only subagents: #N/A mechanism, non-formula root causes, passing-trace regression audit",
    "passing-trace regression audit BEFORE writing: caught 3 real regressions (80-42, 382-10, 463-17/6698) and 1 timeout risk (80-42)",
    "mechanical placeholder-contract validation reproducing the adapter's own _task_template_error logic",
    "compile() every rendered python block and simulate the CHECK snippet against a Worksheet stub (openpyxl is not installed in the optimizer environment)"
  ],
  "guarantees": {
    "edited_files": ["prompt.md", "task_template.md"],
    "no_adapter_harness_scorer_benchmark_or_environment_edits": true,
    "no_environment_mutating_commands": true,
    "placeholders_intact": ["instruction", "spreadsheet_path", "spreadsheet_content", "instruction_type", "answer_position", "output_path", "max_turns"],
    "unknown_placeholders": 0,
    "template_renders": true,
    "task_specific_hardcoding": false
  }
}
